You are a programming expert. 
        You will be provided with a patch used to fix a bug. 
        Based on the commit message and modifications in the patch, you need to analyze the root cause of the bug in detail. 

        Here is the patch content:
        From eb8fc32354aa77678dc6e7950a8f0c79cace204f Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Vincent <vincent.stehle@laposte.net>
Date: Sun, 14 Aug 2016 15:38:29 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] mlxsw: spectrum_router: Fix use after free
MIME-Version: 1.0
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8
Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit

In mlxsw_sp_router_fib4_add_info_destroy(), the fib_entry pointer is used
after it has been freed by mlxsw_sp_fib_entry_destroy(). Use a temporary
variable to fix this.

Fixes: 61c503f976b5449e ("mlxsw: spectrum_router: Implement fib4 add/del switchdev obj ops")
Signed-off-by: Vincent Stehlé <vincent.stehle@laposte.net>
Cc: Jiri Pirko <jiri@mellanox.com>
Acked-by: Ido Schimmel <idosch@mellanox.com>
Signed-off-by: David S. Miller <davem@davemloft.net>
---
 drivers/net/ethernet/mellanox/mlxsw/spectrum_router.c | 3 ++-
 1 file changed, 2 insertions(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/drivers/net/ethernet/mellanox/mlxsw/spectrum_router.c b/drivers/net/ethernet/mellanox/mlxsw/spectrum_router.c
index 81418d629231..90bb93b037ec 100644
--- a/drivers/net/ethernet/mellanox/mlxsw/spectrum_router.c
+++ b/drivers/net/ethernet/mellanox/mlxsw/spectrum_router.c
@@ -1651,9 +1651,10 @@ static void mlxsw_sp_router_fib4_add_info_destroy(void const *data)
 	const struct mlxsw_sp_router_fib4_add_info *info = data;
 	struct mlxsw_sp_fib_entry *fib_entry = info->fib_entry;
 	struct mlxsw_sp *mlxsw_sp = info->mlxsw_sp;
+	struct mlxsw_sp_vr *vr = fib_entry->vr;
 
 	mlxsw_sp_fib_entry_destroy(fib_entry);
-	mlxsw_sp_vr_put(mlxsw_sp, fib_entry->vr);
+	mlxsw_sp_vr_put(mlxsw_sp, vr);
 	kfree(info);
 }
 
-- 
2.25.1


        
        Provide a response strictly in the following format:
        Root cause:<Root cause>

Root cause: The bug was caused by using the `fib_entry` pointer after it had been freed by the `mlxsw_sp_fib_entry_destroy()` function. This resulted in a use-after-free vulnerability, where the code attempted to access the `vr` member of `fib_entry` after it was no longer valid. The fix involved storing the `vr` pointer in a temporary variable before freeing `fib_entry`, ensuring that the code could safely access the `vr` member without dereferencing a freed pointer.

Root cause:
The bug was caused by using the `fib_entry` pointer after it had been freed by the `mlxsw_sp_fib_entry_destroy()` function. This resulted in a use-after-free vulnerability, where the code attempted to access the `vr` member of `fib_entry` after it was no longer valid. The fix involved storing the `vr` pointer in a temporary variable before freeing `fib_entry`, ensuring that the code could safely access the `vr` member without dereferencing a freed pointer.
